vulnerability.explanation: in_reloc_p unconditionally dereferences howto->pc_relative. This backend defines no relocation howtos (pe_loongarch64_std_reloc_howto is empty) and sets cache_ptr->howto = NULL via RTYPE2HOWTO. When any relocation is encountered and in_reloc_p is invoked with that NULL howto, it dereferences a NULL pointer, leading to a crash. This can be triggered by processing a PE/COFF object with relocations for LoongArch64.
